description: As a hydrologist assessing surface water extent for a regional flood risk study, analyze the Landsat multispectral imagery at /home/ga/snap_data/landsat_multispectral.tif in SNAP Desktop. The file contains four spectral bands (band_1=SWIR1, band_2=NIR, band_3=Red, band_4=Green). Derive at least two water-sensitive spectral indices — one based on the green-to-NIR normalized difference and one based on the green-to-SWIR normalized difference — to characterize water body presence from different spectral perspectives. Create a binary water mask that classifies each pixel as water or non-water based on a spectral threshold, and produce a water confidence layer that combines evidence from both indices. Save the complete hydrological analysis product in BEAM-DIMAP format and export the water assessment as GeoTIFF to /home/ga/snap_exports/.
